svg.desc: The final training run is drawn as a single small box - the figure quoted in press releases, such as DeepSeek-V3's disclosed 2.788 million H800 GPU-hours costed at about 5.58 million dollars. Beneath it sit five larger boxes it excludes: failed and abandoned runs, research compute, salaries, data work, and the cluster itself. Epoch AI finds the final run is a minority of total R&D spend.
